title: Marketing & Social Media Associate
text:
Are you a creative and passionate storyteller ready to help shape the voice and brand the new era of exponential science?

Join Atinary Technologies in Lausanne and help us transform R&D from isolated, manual experimentation into a continuous, compounding engine for discovery. Our core mission is to scale Self-Driving Labs®: a new standard for R&D that integrates AI, robotics, and cloud platform into a single, continuously learning system. By removing the bottlenecks of human-driven process speeds, we enable scientists to achieve a year’s worth of experimental output into weeks.

As part of our growth team, you won’t just be creating posts. You’ll be researching trends, bringing fresh ideas, and thinking outside the box to translate complex technology into engaging photo, video, website and written content.

We are looking for a Marketing & Social Media Associate for a fixed-term position with flexible commitment, open to candidates looking for part-time, full-time, or an internship (flexible duration), with a creative mindset, strong visual sense, and a keen interest in editing tools to help communicate our mission and celebrate our customer and team milestones.

About Atinary Technologies

Atinary Technologies is the pioneer of Self-Driving Labs®, a term coined by our founders in 2017. Our mission is to augment human intelligence with AI and robotics to drive a "Moore’s Law of Discovery"; exponentially accelerating the discovery of breakthrough molecules and materials for critical planetary challenges. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, with operations in Boston and Lausanne, Atinary is a fast growing AI startup. Our team values innovation, collaboration, and agility.

A Day in the Life at Atinary

As a Marketing & Social Media Associate, your day-to-day will involve crafting engaging posts for LinkedIn, X and other networks, producing short videos, and creating carousel posts to support our growth team. You will support the overall content creation roadmap, research content trends, and build creative concepts aligned with our brand and customer experience goals.

You will capture and produce photo, video, and written content documenting key customer journey milestones (e.g., production stages, handover events). Beyond digital posts, you’ll support events by assisting with administrative tasks and photo coverage, while also creating internal communications and branding materials.

From writing video scripts for interviews, short clips, and behind-the-scenes footage to leading photographic projects from briefing to delivery, you will play a key role in connecting our brand with scientists and industry leaders worldwide.

Requirements
Must-have:

Recently completed Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Digital Communication, Design, or a related field

Up to 1 year of relevant experience and/or a strong portfolio showcasing photo, video, and written content creation

Proficiency with photo and video editing tools (e.g., Adobe Suite, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, Canva, Photoshop/Lightroom)

Strong creative thinking and ability to translate technology concepts into engaging content

Proven ability to write scripts, short stories, and social media copy (especially for LinkedIn)

Keen interest in technology, science, and digital marketing trends

Excellent communication skills in English and ability to manage projects independently from briefing to delivery

Nice-to-have:

Tech-Savvy Mindset: High comfort level learning and communicating about advanced technology, AI, or scientific topics.

Startup / Fast-Paced Experience: Prior experience or internship exposure in a high-growth startup environment.

Knowledge of basic motion graphics or animation for short video formats.

Benefits
Why you would love working with us:

Make a Real Impact: You won't just be creating social media posts; you'll be shaping the brand voice, storytelling, and digital content presence of a fast-growing AI startup.

Join a Winning Culture: We're committed to a flexible, innovative, and supportive work environment. We have a hybrid policy of 2 home office days per week and we embrace flexible working hours.

Celebrate the Moments that Matter: We believe in celebrating our team's success and important milestones. From company-wide achievements to personal wins, we make sure to recognize and appreciate the moments that contribute to our shared journey.

Work on one of Europe's largest life sciences campuses: Surrounded by over 2,500 people from the world's most innovative companies and research groups.

Disclaimer

Please note that only candidates who are legally authorized to work in Switzerland will be considered for this position. 

Please submit your resume (CV) and a portfolio showcasing your relevant work. Only applications containing both a CV and a portfolio will be considered for this position.

Atinary is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We seek a friendly, respectful, professional, collaborative and inspiring atmosphere and work environment for every employee, collaborator and client regardless of gender, physical appearance, sexual orientation, disability, age, race or religion.

title: AI for Chemistry Scientist
text:
Are you a Scientist at the intersection of AI and cheminformatics, ready to build the intelligence driving the next age of science?

Join Atinary Technologies in Lausanne and help us transform R&D from manual experimentation into a continuous, compounding engine for discovery. Our core mission is to scale Self-Driving Labs®: a new standard for R&D that integrates AI, robotics, and cloud software into a single, continuously learning system. By removing the bottlenecks of human-driven process speeds, we enable scientists to achieve a year's worth of experimental output into weeks.

As part of our lean, high-velocity team, you'll be combining machine learning with chemical insight to build methods that are genuinely useful to bench scientists.

About Atinary Technologies

Atinary Technologies is the pioneer of Self-Driving Labs®, a term coined by our founders in 2017. Our mission is to augment human intelligence with AI and robotics to drive a "Moore's Law of Discovery"; exponentially accelerating the discovery of breakthrough molecules and materials for critical planetary challenges. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, with operations in Boston and Lausanne, Atinary is a fast growing AI startup. Our team values innovation, collaboration, and agility.

Role Overview

We are looking for a scientist with a chemistry and cheminformatics background to join our AI research team. Our group develops the algorithms that form the backbone of our platform, SDLabs®. These are built on mathematically grounded, probabilistic ML tools, particularly Gaussian processes and Bayesian optimization, alongside more modern approaches such as LLMs and foundation models. Having recently opened our own autonomous self-driving lab, we are looking for someone who can develop methods tailored to the lab and unlock its full potential.

Our environment is built on shared ownership: you'll take your own research from idea to robust, tested algorithms in production, working alongside AI scientists, software engineers, and chemists to make sure they hold up against real-world requirements. Whether you're benchmarking a new approach, tuning a model on experimental data, or translating a paper into working code, your work directly accelerates discovery.

Above all, you are an essential part of a mission-driven team dedicated to scaling the future of Self-Driving Labs®.

Requirements

Must-have:

PhD (preferred) or MSc in Computational Chemistry, Chemistry, or a related field

Excellent communication in English, enabling effective collaboration with both technical and non-technical team members

Familiarity with molecular representations and cheminformatics tooling (RDKit or similar)

Strong foundations in machine learning, ideally with a focus on probabilistic modeling or optimization

Hands-on experience with at least one of: Bayesian optimization, Gaussian processes, active learning, or experimental design

Proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices to produce clean, tested, maintainable code

Ability to translate new ideas and papers from the literature into production-ready components

Sharp analytical skills for interpreting complex problems and generating actionable insights

Nice-to-have:

Background or demonstrated interest in high-throughput experimentation

Experience with fine-tuning foundation models / LLMs

Publications in top-tier ML or ML-for-science venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR)

A track record of deploying ML in a product setting or working with engineering teams

Benefits

Why you would love working with us:

Make a Real Impact: You will help shape the core intelligence of a fast-growing AI startup.

Join a Winning Culture: We're committed to a flexible, innovative, and supportive work environment. We have a hybrid policy of 2 home office days per week and we embrace flexible working hours.

Celebrate the Moments that Matter: We believe in celebrating our team's success and important milestones. From company-wide achievements to personal wins, we make sure to recognize and appreciate the moments that contribute to our shared journey.

Work on one of Europe's largest life sciences campuses: Surrounded by over 2,500 people from the world's most innovative companies and research groups.

Disclaimer

Please note that only candidates who are legally authorized to work in Switzerland will be considered for this position.

Please submit your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and verifiable track record. Candidates need to be prepared to submit two references from past employers and supervisors in the final steps of the interview process.

Atinary is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We seek a friendly, respectful, professional, collaborative and inspiring atmosphere and work environment for every employee, collaborator and client regardless of gender, physical appearance, sexual orientation, disability, age, race or religion.

title: Full Stack Developer
text:

Our core mission is to scale Self-Driving Labs®: a new standard for R&D that integrates AI, robotics, and cloud software into a single, continuously learning system. By removing the bottlenecks of human-driven process speeds, we enable scientists to achieve a year’s worth of experimental output in a single week.

As part of our lean, high-velocity team, you won’t just be writing code. You’ll be architecting the new age of scientific discovery. We are generalists who tackle complex structural problems.

We are looking for engineers with a “solver” mindset to help us transform experimental data into a strategic global asset. If you have strong software foundations and experience with our core languages, you can help bridge the gap between human concepts and machine-scale breakthroughs.

About Atinary Technologies

Atinary Technologies is the pioneer of Self-Driving Labs®, a term coined by our founders in 2017. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, with operations in Boston and Lausanne, Atinary is a fast growing AI startup. Our team values innovation, collaboration, and agility.

​

A Day in the Life at Atinary

As a Full Stack Developer here, your day is a dynamic blend of deep focus and high-velocity collaboration. One week you might work on architecting robust lab integrations that close the loop between physical experimentation and digital analysis. Another week, you might focus on crafting agentic features that guide scientists through complex discovery workflows. We recognize that great ideas need room to marinate, so you're encouraged to organize your schedule to make space for focus work and explore new concepts. 

Our environment is built on shared ownership; you’ll engage in meaningful code reviews and work alongside peers to ship impactful product updates that evolve SDLabs®, the Atinary platform. Whether you are optimizing backend logic or refining responsive UI components, your work directly empowers researchers to solve real-world challenges. 

You aren't just writing code, you are an essential part of a mission-driven team dedicated to scaling the future of Self-Driving Labs®.

Our Tech Stack

React, Typescript and fully typed REST API in the Frontend

Django, Python, Redis, Celery, Postgres in the Backend

Agentic system build on top of strands

Temporal to build durable lab workflows

Hosted on AWS with support from Posthog and Sentry

Github, Slack, Linear

Requirements

Must-have:

Strong knowledge of TypeScript and/or Python

Experience building single-page applications and engaging user interfaces

Backend development experience with a focus on maintainability and performance

Working experience with LLM-guided development 

Strong analytical skills for interpreting complex problems and generating actionable insights

Excellent communication in English, enabling effective collaboration with both technical and non-technical team members

Bachelor's or preferably Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Chemistry, Bioinformatics, or a related field

Nice-to-have:

Knowledge in distributed architectures

Experience with AWS

Knowledge in data engineering and/or automation

Experience working in a regulated environment (e.g. HIPAA, SOC 2)

Knowledge in Chemistry and/or biochemistry
